mail/imap_metadata#

Values read out of IMAP responses: response codes, LIST entries, flags, UID ranges and SEARCH results.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

Values read out of IMAP responses: response codes, LIST entries, flags, UID ranges and SEARCH results. ImapSession uses them.
